datasets.description: Seven native production fuel categories, Mtoe. Exact current-country aliases are mapped; historical entities, regional and world aggregates remain in a separate collection. Conflicting and repeated source cells are not silently combined.

datasets.title: EIA international energy · native physical measures · 1973 onward; coverage varies
datasets.license: U.S. government public domain; acknowledgment requested
datasets.description: Twenty-eight literal annual energy measures in publisher physical or energy-content units. Earliest selected source years begin in 1973 for some series; most country coverage begins in 1980 or later. The selected original series lines retain every native observation and source metadata. Broader monthly/quarterly and alternative-unit series remain accessible in the original publisher bulk download.
datasets.source_fingerprint_meaning: SHA-256 of the exact retained publisher CSV/HTML, or the exact selected original JSON series lines; full bulk archive hashes are separately recorded.
